sourceFacts: male, age thirty-nine, Xuandun International direct-command special tactical team leader, codename Silence
right eye is blind and permanently covered by an eyepatch
leads a unit that uses awakened operatives to hunt hostile awakened targets
his silence domain is combat-only; standard portrait must not depict sound waves, supernatural silence, aura or power effects
designAssumptions: lean athletic Chinese man with short black hair, a stern weathered face, a brown visible left eye and a plain matte black eyepatch over the right eye
wears restrained charcoal-black special-operations uniform with a high collar, matte protective vest, small shoulder plates, black gloves, utility belt, straight black trousers and combat boots
stands perfectly still with both arms relaxed at his sides, facing the viewer without displaying a weapon
2026-08-29 visual refresh: an austere sensor eyepatch integrated into asymmetrical special-action armor
sceneConcept: A stern thirty-nine-year-old Chinese special tactical team leader stands perfectly still against a transparent background. His right blind eye is covered by a plain matte black eyepatch, while his visible brown left eye watches the viewer calmly. He wears a restrained charcoal-black high-collared special-operations uniform, matte protective vest, compact shoulder plates, black gloves, utility belt, straight black trousers and combat boots. Both arms rest naturally at his sides. Soft even frontal studio light defines the silhouette without dramatic edge reflections. Visual refresh: an austere sensor eyepatch integrated into asymmetrical special-action armor.
naturalLanguageDetail: A stern thirty-nine-year-old Chinese special tactical team leader with a plain matte black eyepatch over his blind right eye stands perfectly still in restrained charcoal-black high-collared armor, both arms relaxed at his sides, under soft even frontal studio light; an austere sensor eyepatch integrated into asymmetrical special-action armor.
